title: magnolia × soulangeana var. lennei
intro: Magnolia × soulangeana var. lennei, commonly known as Lenne's Magnolia or Lenne Magnolia, is a hybrid plant derived from the cross between Magnolia denudata and Magnolia liliiflora, characterized by its stunning white flowers and purple center. The plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lenne's Magnolia include reducing stress, anxiety, and inflammation, as well as exhibiting potential anti-cancer and antiviral effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include magnolol, honokiol, and other lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries.
